notes.official: Dimensions, dry mass, combined payload budget and speed from product/datasheet. 8.2 kgf is whole-vehicle static thrust, NOT per motor.
notes.battery: 2.4 kg for two batteries is manufacturer's product-table example; actual lab battery set is unconfirmed.
notes.geometry: Motor axes estimated from official RevA CAD rotor geometry: x=-0.5075, y=+/-0.2944, z=-0.1355 m. These replace the earlier 0.74 m hull-center spacing used for the thrust arms. Equivalent buoyancy boxes retain 0.74 m hull-center spacing. Confirm COM and motor axes on the lab boat.
notes.propulsion: Quasi-static 16 V M200 + weedless curve from paired manufacturer thrust/RPM samples. Whole-vehicle forward limit remains 8.2 kgf; reverse is conservatively capped at the measured 2.81 kgf per motor. RPM under way can differ due to inflow, voltage and installation; these corrections and motor transients remain uncalibrated.
notes.estimates: Inertia, COM, equivalent buoyancy boxes and damping are engineering assumptions. Surge damping fits the 3 m/s/8.2 kgf envelope, not measured resistance data. No added mass or waves in baseline.
